propositions: Jira-family-general symbols (identity convention, probe classifier, value maps, link vocabulary, sanitizers) currently reside in the Cloud adapter and are imported cross-package without sanctioned seams, violating ADR 0035

A new `adapters/jira_family/` package must become the single canonical home for shared Jira symbols, with `adapters/jira/` acting as a Cloud-specific contract-construction site (not a re-export shim), and `adapters/jira_datacenter/` reusing those symbols in J6/J7

Location-pinned modules (`adf.py`, `comment_limits.py`, `outbound_fields.py`) cannot move; symbols inside them are shared by dependency inversion (imports flow upward to jira_family contracts, never downward), and new absolute imports into those modules must survive `spec_from_file_location` loads under synthetic module names

Value maps must be de-duplicated from two independently-maintained copies to one canonical definition in `jira_family/`, with the deliberate behavioral change `deleted -> Done` (fixing the latent bug where ACLI emitted invalid `Deleted` state) pinned by test

All ACLI transport modules (`acli*.py`) change only in import lines (re-pointed to jira_family symbols via aliased imports to preserve `__all__` and call-site names), with zero behavioral logic modifications and zero re-export shims left behind

An AST-walking import-graph test must persistently enforce the acyclic contract: no adapter imports a sibling's symbols, and `jira_family/` imports neither `adapters/jira/` nor `adapters/jira_datacenter/`
